reviewer: Codex, separate from the implementing agent; prior reviewer familiarity disclosed
scope: Installed-environment usability review on development data, not clean-install validation, independent human feedback or biological validation
head: 389f2d7d168cfa9b4b76af2366a4e2d1cce4289d

criteria.prepare_new_input: met: reviewer-selected 2yztA00, five replicas per group, frames 13:130
criteria.complete_run: met: three CLI runs, no implementation edits
criteria.identify_exclusions_and_causes_from_excl: partly met: 10 excluded channel-windows identifiable; exact numbering_discontinuity requires members JSON
criteria.explain_limitations: met: descriptive only, correlated finite samples, exposed development data, C-alpha only, same-start limitations, no significance or causal interpretation

new_dataset.selection_reason: Existing non-cohort development domain; 66 residues; not the prior pilot domain. Short replicas require a common 130-frame interval. No selection using scores.
new_dataset.frames: 13:130:1; first 13 excluded by the existing 10% convention; no equilibration claim

independent_js_check.method: Entropy-form Jensen-Shannon distance calculated independently from saved histogram counts; compared to six-significant-digit CSV

mapping_check.method: Separate h5py read; C-alpha atom indices parsed directly from embedded PDB ATOM/HETATM records; compared across all ten new-domain member exports
mapping_check.limitation: same HDF5 decoder, not an independent file-format implementation

obstacles: Exact exclusion causes are not in exclusions.csv; intermediates are required. Deleting members/ removes that explanation.
Environment setup is assumed: two existing interpreters and local MD data. A fresh-machine installation was not tested.
Existing output directories can be overwritten; fresh output directories were used.
The report displays a default global pbc value although per-member policies are the effective settings.
The worked reading uses five replicas per group, whereas the handoff command uses three; identical numerical results should not be expected.
recommendation: Operationally usable on the documented installed environment; qualified pilot pass, with exclusion-cause criterion partly met. Next: inline exact exclusion reasons and first outside-user trial; no new inference campaign.
